_why: Runtimes that installed manager phones report but that the normal `eas update`
every merge to each entry here (both the production and preview channels).
app.json uses runtimeVersion.policy 'appVersion' with version '1.0.0', so the
normal publish already targets '1.0.0' — the runtime the installed build
reports. The list is therefore empty and must stay empty while those agree.
THE MOMENT expo.version CHANGES, add the PREVIOUS version here: under the
appVersion policy a bump mints a new runtime, and every phone still running the
old binary stops receiving updates. CI's native-runtime-guard job enforces this.
